items.statement: Overdraft utilization has been higher for past few months, tapering down towards end of Q4 FY25
items.quote: One is that the overdraft utilization has been on the higher side for the past few months. In terms of utilization, overdraft facilities are usually taken from the banks for these purposes that whenever there is an outflow which is required to be done in terms of trade payables and all, the utilization is on the higher side and again it tapers down towards the end of the fourth quarter.

items.statement: Preferential issue withdrawn due to turbulent market conditions; no impact on cash flow or liquidity; may be revisited in 3-4 months when markets stabilize
items.quote: The withdrawal of preferential issue will have no bearing on the cash flow or the liquidity of our company. We are well and sufficiently financed. So to that extent, it doesn't affect our functioning or operations in any manner. Yes, the market conditions are turbulent at the moment, and the investor would have thought otherwise. And they decided to postpone it for a while until the markets are in

items.statement: Operating cash flow positive INR 7 crore for nine months ended December FY25
items.quote: For the nine months ended, there is a net positive cash flow of INR 7 crores, because of which the debt has come down compared to March levels,

items.statement: Net debt reduced by INR13 crores from INR896 crores to INR883 crores in Q3 FY25
items.quote: It's a net debt level. So , last quarter, it was INR896 crores. And this quarter, this is INR883 crores. So, we have repaid around INR13 crores.

items.statement: Granted 60,000 stock options representing 0.5% of outstanding share capital as part of 2.5% ESOP pool
items.quote: We have granted 60,000 stock options, representing 0.5% of our current outstanding share capital as a part of our 2.5% ESOP pool.
